description: This file defines the 'UploadedFile' class implementing the PSR-7 'UploadedFileInterface' for handling file uploads within the Slim Framework. It includes methods for accessing the file stream, moving uploaded files, and parsing global upload data.

classes.name: UploadedFile
classes.description: Represents an uploaded file, providing methods to retrieve file info, move the file, and handle streams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an UploadedFile instance with file information, media type, size, error code, and environment indicator.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a stream representing the uploaded file.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a new location, handling different target types and environment specifics.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the status code of the upload error.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename provided by the client.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type of the uploaded file.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes.
